lead.headline: Rice is out again — start Jacobs, and claim Loveland before Wednesday
lead.deck: Saturday found no new doubt. Jacobs over Gordon before 11:00 Sunday; Loveland for Stroud before Wed 01:00 CDMX.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Rashee Rice is ruled out for a second straight week, and you still trail Furia Regia 41.5 to 0 with ESPN at 38%. Saturday's re-check found nothing new against you. Matthew Golden was limited Wednesday and Thursday with a shoulder but carries no designation; George Pickens practised in full and is not among Dallas's designations; Josh Jacobs is undesignated after six weeks on the exempt list. Jacobs over Gordon is the projection's coin flip — make it before Gordon kicks off at 11:00. Cole Kmet is on injured reserve, so the Loveland claim stands: drop C.J. Stroud after his game, before waivers clear Wednesday at 01:00.

doFirst.headline: Jacobs in on Sunday; Loveland claim before Wednesday
doFirst.deck: Start Jacobs over Gordon before 11:00 Sunday; claim Loveland, dropping Stroud, before Wed 01:00 CDMX.
doFirst.note: Jacobs over Gordon is a coin flip (0.9) taken by projection; leave Gordon in only if doubt surfaces by Sun 10:30. Loveland costs your waiver priority (5th, never resets). Hold the Jets D/ST (8.0 against the Titans' 7.7) and Gay (9.6 against Butker's 10.2).
doFirst.empty: Nothing else to fire this Saturday morning.
